hypothesis: On organizer-declared empty real tunnel frames, frozen low, suspended, contour-edge, longitudinal and measured-surface-attached boxes yield both intersecting and nonintersecting reference-contour labels without post hoc scenario selection.
criterion: Each semantic group has both full-form contour-intersecting and nonintersecting cases, edge positives and measured-surface placements are nonempty, full-form and observed-support labels remain separate, and zero-return cases remain visible in the report. This is panel validity, not detector acceptance.
sensor_model_limit: Measured return slots only; opaque first-return replacement. The 0.01m noise and intensity are uncalibrated; no extrapolation to Pandar128 detection range or multiple-return behavior.

placement_height_semantics: rest_height_m is above the estimated rail running surface; world placement and contour labels both use this datum.
label_semantics: For every frame, sample the amodal box volume on a fixed 4cm lattice against that frame’s selected reference contour. Separately classify visible inserted returns. Nominal mode is only a placement parameter.
adjacent_sequence_policy: Start at the PR #34 frozen 5cm first-frame clearance. If a world-fixed box crosses a later-frame contour, source geometry alone shifts it outward on a 2cm grid to the first nonintersecting placement, then adds 5cm guard. Record that correction; never consult detector outputs.
measured_surface_split: Flush negative uses the measured far-side wall; protruding positive uses the near-side trough. Both surface contacts are audited from source returns.
measured_surface_policy: Iterate surface choice on the actual box x-footprint and its current vertical ground estimate; require at least 8 measured source points and audit nearest outer-face gap.
